Package com.mytrip.model

Class Trip

java.lang.Object
com.mytrip.model.Trip
@Entity public class Trip extends Object
Represents a road trip planned through the MyTrip application. A Trip stores route information, vehicle fuel information, expenses, and the traveler's budget.

    • calculateFuelCost

      public BigDecimal calculateFuelCost()
      Calculates the estimated fuel cost.
      Returns:
      estimated fuel cost rounded to two decimal places
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if distance, MPG, or fuel price is invalid

    • calculateTotalCost

      public BigDecimal calculateTotalCost()
      Calculates the total estimated trip cost.
      Returns:
      combined fuel, lodging, and activity expenses

    • calculateBudgetDifference

      public BigDecimal calculateBudgetDifference()
      Calculates how far under or over budget the trip is. A positive result means the trip is under budget. A negative result means the trip is over budget.
      Returns:
      budget minus the total estimated cost
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if no budget has been provided

    • getBudgetDifference

      public BigDecimal getBudgetDifference()
